body: Glycemic index ranks how fast a carb raises blood sugar, but it ignores portion size. Glycemic load multiplies the index by the grams of carbohydrate you actually eat. Watermelon has a high index and a low load, because a serving holds very little carbohydrate.
title: Glycemic load beats glycemic index
use: Judge a food by the carbs in your real portion, not by a ranking.
